turns.question: Which customer has spent the most with us over all their orders, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or dimension that breaks spend down by individual customer (revenue can be split only by customer country, signup date, order status, amount and date), so I cannot name the top-spending customer. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (gross revenue of non-cancelled orders), net_revenue_eur and customers_distinct (active customers), which I can give in total or by customer country.
